risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (371.84) combined with recent CPI event and earnings in 20 days creates severe macro headwinds for AVGO despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term uptrend (EMA 50/200 bullish, PSAR bullish) remains intact and extreme VIX fear (371.84) presents classic contrarian opportunity for patient swing traders.
